name: runflux
description: Visual backend compiler — design a workflow visually, compile it into a real deployable backend.
author: Juan Pablo Farias <juanpablofarias.com>

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:node --workspaces --if-present && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:plugins
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/compiler/templates/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build:node --workspaces --if-present && npm run build --workspace=@runflux/app-workflow-editor && node scripts/verify-plugin-catalog.mjs
